outputs.explanation: Panel A is a spatial transcriptomics cluster map (micrograph-like spatial image showing cluster assignments), not a plot of averaged data requiring individual data points.
Panel B shows H&E histology images with manual region annotations; it is a photograph/micrograph, not a plot of averaged data.

Panel C shows an H&E image and spatial expression heatmap-style plots overlaid on tissue; these are spatial visualizations of expression per spot, not averaged summary plots requiring individual data point overlay.
Panel D consists of GSEA enrichment plots (line plots), which are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

Panel E is a bar graph showing log2 fold change values (derived from differential expression analysis, i.e., averaged/summary statistics) for multiple genes, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
